name: Savory Bacon & Cheddar Corn Grits
whyItWorks: Quick-cooking white hominy grits cook down ultra-soft and soothing.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Simmer 1/4 cup quick grits in 1 cup chicken bone broth for 5 mins. Stir in butter and sharp cheddar. Top with finely crumbled crispy bacon and a soft-poached egg.
